snippet.title: Huntsman teaser trailer - PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct
snippet.description:
If you love to be scared, then Huntsman is sure to send shivers down your spine. Run from a giant huntsman spider, but beware of the orb weaver that lays traps to ensnare you in.
